name: Sub-Con
source:
A mysterious girl who hijacks display devices throughout Tokyo to perform guerilla concerts.

Considered by most to be a form of virtual idol. Commonly referred to as simply Sub-Con.

[Spoiler]A consciousness which emerged from the mesh network and was given form by [url=/c34599]Hogyo Iria[/url].[/spoiler]

[From the in-game profile]
